office: Connecticut Secretary of the State (Election Management System public reporting)

feeds.what: statewide vote totals for every office of the election (363 offices, including town offices), ids only
feeds.notes: Shape: { officeId: [ { candidateId: { V: '742720', TO: '57.26%' } }, … ] }. Numbers are strings. URL = /ng-app/data/election/<electionId>/<version>/stateVotes_Electiondata.json. 35,851 bytes decoded, 8,430 on the wire (gzip). Each party line of a cross-endorsed candidate is a separate candidateId (see candidateGrouping).
{"Version":53582}. Fetch this first on every poll; the data files live under that version number.

feeds.what: lookup tables: offices (title, type, district), candidates (name, party id), parties, towns, counties, polling places
feeds.notes: Needed to name anything. officeList[] = [{ '19663': {ID, NM:'Governor and Lieutenant Governor', OT:'SW', OO:'1', DT:'', D:'0'} }, …]; candidateIds = { '44186': {NM, LN, FN, MN, P: partyId, AD, CO} }; partyIds = { '1': {CD:'D', NM:'Democratic Party', P:'250'} }. PRIVACY: candidateIds[].AD is each candidate's street address — do not republish it.

feeds.what: fusion totals: each cross-endorsed candidate's votes combined across party lines
feeds.notes: Same shape as stateVotes but only for offices that have cross-endorsements, keyed by the candidate's major-party candidateId. Governor: stateVotes has Lamont/Bysiewicz D 742,720 and WF 29,831 as two rows; here one row 772,551 (59.56%). Offices absent from this file have no fusion candidates.

feeds.what: statewide header numbers: ballots cast, precincts and towns reporting, turnout
ballot questions, keyed by town name (24 towns; all local — no statewide question in 2026)

feeds.notes: Not needed for statewide totals. The site also loads townVotes_, officePrecincts_, voterTurnout_ and reports_Electiondata.json from the same folder (seen in the request log, not fetched).
64 entries: [{"ID":"108","Name":"11/03/2026 -- November 2026 State Election","DefaultElection":"Y"}, …]. The date is only inside Name (MM/DD/YYYY prefix).

election_id: 108 (the site's election ID), the path segment after /election/. Version at fetch time: 53582, the next segment.
discovery: GET https://ctemspublic.tgstg.net/ng-app/data/Elections.json → entry with DefaultElection 'Y' or a Name starting with the election date; then /ng-app/data/election/<ID>/Version.json for the version.
cors: none (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin on the JSON files when sent Origin: https://openslate.us)
bot_blocking: Plain relay User-Agent: 200 on all files (Server: cloudflare, cf-cache-status DYNAMIC, no challenge). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: No timestamp in any file looked at. Version.json's number (53582) changes on each publish; Elections.json answered last-modified 'Tue, 10 Nov 2026 20:00:00 GMT'. The last-modified header of the versioned files was not checked for meaning.
reporting_field: Statewide only, as display strings in election_Electiondata.json: PR '774 of 774 (100%)' (polling places), T '169 of 169' (towns reported), PT '0 of 169' (towns partially reported). Per town in townStatus_Electiondata.json: PR '7 of 7 (100.00%)'. No per-contest reporting figure in stateVotes.
choice_format: Candidate and party are joined through ids: stateVotes row { '44186': {V:'742720', TO:'57.26%'} } → candidateIds['44186'] = {NM:'Ned Lamont and Susan Bysiewicz', LN, FN, MN, P:'1'} → partyIds['1'] = {CD:'D', NM:'Democratic Party'}. Because of fusion voting the same ticket appears again under another party ('WF' Working Families Party, 29,831) with a different candidateId; add the lines, or read candidateGrouping. Write-ins are candidates with party CD 'WI'. Questions: YES / NO string counts per town.
district_field: Separate fields in officeList: OT is the office type (SW statewide, C Congress, S State Senate, A State Representative, PD probate, SM municipal), D is the district number ('1'), DT a label ('Connecticut 01'). The number is also the end of the title ('State Senator 1').
